''See also: [[Emala Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Emala was a [[Rune Queen]] who perished during the [[Dread War]]. During her time as a [[Sage]], she likely led an army of lesser [[Lords]] and [[Golds]] during a siege. To protect [[Shatterspine Castle]], she dismantled one of her Arrays to establish a seal around the [[fortress]]. It is believed that she intended to return to this location, as her actions served to preserve various lesser [[scripts]]. Currently, fragments of her [[Grand Oath Array]] remain within the city, and her residual [[madra]] and specialized techniques are considered highly valuable for study or reconstruction.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Once a [[Sage]], Emala eventually ascended to become the [[Rune Queen]] and a powerful [[Monarch]]. She utilized her [[madra]] to command a [[Grand Oath Array]] composed of runes derived from the ancient runes, which she also left behind in the form of script-circle{{!}}script-circles. During the [[Dread War]], Emala died and sacrificed one of her Arrays to maintain a seal around [[Shatterspine Castle]].}}
